findings.title: Conditional serializer hook misnamed and never runs
findings.body: In app/serializers/user_serializer.rb:153 the method is defined as `include_website_name` without a trailing `?`. ActiveModel::Serializer looks for `include_website_name?` as done for every other conditional attribute in the file (`include_email?`, `include_stats?`). Therefore the `website.present?` guard never runs and `website_name` is always serialized, even when `website` is blank where it returns nil.

findings.title: website_name leaks for TL0 users hidden from anonymous
findings.body: In app/serializers/user_serializer.rb:105 `untrusted_attributes` hides `website`, `location`, `bio_*`, etc. from anonymous viewers when the user is TL0 via `restrict_user_fields?`, but newly added `website_name` is not in that list. An anonymous client is therefore still sent the website host via `website_name` even when `website` itself is suppressed, defeating the trust-level privacy protection and disclosing user data.

findings.title: Subdomain comparison matches unrelated domains sharing public suffix
findings.body: In app/serializers/user_serializer.rb:144 same-length hosts are considered same-site if `split('.')[1..-1].join('.')` is equal. That only compares the last N-1 labels, so unrelated domains sharing a public suffix like website `evil.co.uk` vs instance `other.co.uk` both share `co.uk` and are treated as same site. The code then returns host plus path as if internal, misleading users into thinking an external site is part of the instance.

findings.title: Nil current hostname crashes user serialization
findings.body: In app/serializers/user_serializer.rb:139 `discourse_host = Discourse.current_hostname` is used without a nil guard, then `discourse_host.split('.')` on line 144 and `discourse_host.ends_with?` on line 149 are called. If the hostname is nil in console, tests, or misconfiguration, serialization raises NoMethodError and breaks the entire UserSerializer response with a 500.

findings.title: Untrusted-attributes test omits website_name
findings.body: In spec/serializers/user_serializer_spec.rb:11 the `untrusted_attributes` list checked for TL0 anonymous hiding does not include `website_name`. The test therefore still passes while the serializer leaks `website_name` for those users, so the privacy regression has no coverage.
